meaning: Protected source is unread evidence, not an empty field. No hidden token may create certainty about a country, topic or occupation. The late portal-only pass reads restored source, preserving the native handling of comments and reference annotations.
scope: Source-only conservative refusal. Portal selection is a user maintenance preference, not a mandatory style rule.
guardLocations: late portal-only pass after legacy restoration and before final prose spacing
limits: No template expansion or subject fact lookup.
Placeholder examples are synthetic and are not evidence of native rendered facts.
The late source view masks hard literals and quotations, leaves comments and reference annotations readable, and does not run general cleanup again.

literalFamilyIdentity.rule: A normalized key is not native title identity. Require the exact native profile title, allowing MediaWiki first-letter equivalence and local namespace prefixes, or one exact pinned native taxon emitter title.

taxonGenericScope.effect: The exact native taxon infobox can establish generic Biologia without a readable kingdom. Unknown, dynamic or placeholder kingdom content never establishes Zoologia or a narrower group.
taxonGenericScope.previousFixtureCorrection: The earlier no-portal expectation for an exact native Taxobox with an unread kingdom was too broad. Its failed execution receipt is retained. Separate unproved interior-case titles require no portal.
